purpose: Stock meaning of progression and rider-stat battery fields for modern save UX.

fields.+4: FAILED (did not finish: time or best lap >= 60000)

rider_stats.derived: LOST = PLAYED - WON; screen percentages are count*100/PLAYED
rider_stats.counted: P1 always; P2 only when its rider index (0x0749) < 16, so CPU opponents are not counted

tour_flags.cleared: row on medal award; all on rider confirm

tour_medal_snapshot.meaning: medal cell at tour confirm; drives the run label and the keep-row test on leaving TRACK_SELECT

vs_tally.meaning: P1 / P2 win counts, zeroed on VS entry and shown on VS track select; 0x10A9 also counts 1P wins harmlessly

won_is_offset_2_and_bumps_vs_tally.meaning: INC 0x0232 + offset, then INC 0x10A9 (P1 side; P2 uses 0x10AB at 80:CAB4)

failed_is_offset_4.meaning: INC 0x0234 + offset; called when the loser's time/best lap is >= 60000 (80:C7EF, 80:C8D7)

player_scores_reads_16_riders.meaning: X=0, Y=15 loop over 0x0230,X; LOST = PLAYED - WON (SBC 0x0232,X), not stored

tour_confirm_snapshots_medal.meaning: 0x10D1 = medal cell (16*$D0 + rider) when the tour is confirmed

vs_entry_resets_tally_and_sets_mode.meaning: 0x10A9 = 0x10AB = 0, 0x10AD = 2 on VS entry (1P tour entry writes 0x10AD = 1 at 80:BBD6)
